newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nisshin Oil to build new plant -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Nisshin Oil to build new plant -- paper.

text.p: Japan's largest edible oil producer Nisshin Oil Mills Ltd has decided to build a plant in Sakai, western Japan, a Japanese newspaper reported on Thursday.
Nisshin will invest 3.5 billion yen in the first phase of the plant, the economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said in its evening edition.
Nisshin Oil officials were not immediately available for comment.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Nisshin Oil would initially build an edible oil refining facility capable of refining 200 tonnes of edible oil a day, a shipping facility and an office building.
It said the company would start construction of the first phase of the new plant in early 1997 and aimed to start operations there in January, 1998.

The paper said the planned plant was part of the company's review of its production and distribution in western Japan, under which it would transfer part of production process to the new plant from its plant in Kobe, which is also western Japan.
